entities.summary: Saeeda Etebari is an Afghan jewelry artist. Etebari had meningitis when she was one, causing her to be deaf. She joined the Turquoise Mountain Institute for Afghan Arts and Architecture and trained in jewelry-making. She was chosen to have an exhibition at the Smithsonian in Washington D.C. She was recognized on the BBC's "100 Women 2021" list.
